output.summary: KEP-2129 proposed deprecating and removing cAdvisor v1 JSON metrics (ContainerInfo and MachineInfo endpoints) from the kubelet, as a step toward removing cAdvisor APIs from the kubelet. Its status is implemented, stage stable.
output.rationale: cAdvisor only supports Linux and a small set of runtimes, so sig-node wants vendors to replace cAdvisor without double-collection cost. The JSON endpoints were already disabled by default from 1.18 and re-enableable via --enable-cadvisor-json-endpoints, and the KEP re-visits removal given concerns raised about removing them permanently. Out of scope: Prometheus cAdvisor metrics, the Summary API, and the kubelet's cAdvisor dependence.

alternatives.option: Keep the cAdvisor json endpoints, either removing them later or keeping cAdvisor in the kubelet
alternatives.why_not: Listed as the alternative in the KEP; the KEP instead pursues removal as a step toward removing cAdvisor from the kubelet.

alternatives.option: Consume the metrics in JSON format from Prometheus instead of from cAdvisor directly
alternatives.why_not: Raised as a possible migration path by a reviewer (ehashman) in rcomment:565517608; the sources do not say it was adopted as the decision.

alternatives.option: Keep cAdvisor json metrics as part of the original metrics overhaul KEP
alternatives.why_not: The readme says this was originally part of the metrics overhaul KEP but was removed from it because it had not been completed.

evidence.quote: cAdvisor json metrics were disabled by default starting in 1.18, and could be re-enabled by setting `--enable-cadvisor-json-endpoints` to true.
However, given the concerns about removing the endpoints, we want to re-visit the deprecation and removal of these metrics before removing them permanently.
The `--enable-cadvisor-json-endpoints` flag only covers cAdvisor json APIs defined in https://github.com/google/cadvisor/tree/master/info
/milestone 1.21 since this should be closed, we have implemented it in 1.21.
